mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT bld_id FROM residency WHERE res_flr = '옥탑층') rt ON rt.bld_id = b.bld_id

( (CASE h.risk_grade WHEN '고위험고립' THEN 30 WHEN '사회적고립' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN x.old75_cnt > 0 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN x.severe_cnt > 0 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN h.basic_living_yn = 'Y' OR h.near_poor_yn = 'Y' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN x.pension_cnt > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN a.nhis_arrears_yn = 'Y' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN h.care_burden_yn = 'Y' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN r.res_flr LIKE '지하%' OR r.res_flr = '옥탑층' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) )

SELECT r.hh_id resident_id , r.res_flr , r.dong_nm , r.ho_nm , h.hh_mbr_cnt , h.hh_type , h.risk_grade , hd.mbr_nm head_nm , hd.birth_day , x.max_age , x.old75_cnt , x.severe_cnt , x.pension_cnt , h.near_poor_yn , h.basic_living_yn , h.care_burden_yn , IFNULL(a.nhis_arrears_yn, 'N') arrears_yn , priority FROM residency r JOIN household h ON h.hh_id = r.hh_id JOIN (SELECT p.hh_id , MAX(p.age) max_age , COUNT(CASE WHEN p.age >= 75 THEN 1 END) old75_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dsbl_grade_nm = '심한 장애' THEN 1 END) severe_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN p.basic_pension_yn = 'Y' THEN 1 END) pension_cnt FROM person p JOIN residency r2 ON r2.hh_id = p.hh_id AND r2.bld_id = #{bldId} GROUP BY p.hh_id) x ON x.hh_id = r.hh_id LEFT JOIN person hd ON hd.hh_id = r.hh_id AND hd.head_rel = '본인' LEFT JOIN arrears a ON a.residency_id = r.residency_id AND a.arrears_type = 'HEALTH_INS' WHERE r.bld_id = #{bldId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) hh_cnt , IFNULL(SUM(y.hh_mbr_cnt), 0) mbr_cnt , IFNULL(SUM(y.risk_grade = '고위험고립'), 0) high_risk_hh , IFNULL(SUM(y.risk_grade = '사회적고립'), 0) social_iso_hh , IFNULL(SUM(y.old75_cnt), 0) old75 , IFNULL(SUM(y.severe_cnt), 0) severe_dsbl , IFNULL(SUM(y.basic_living_yn = 'Y' OR y.near_poor_yn = 'Y'), 0) near_poor_hh , IFNULL(SUM(y.pension_cnt), 0) pension_cnt , IFNULL(SUM(y.arrears_yn = 'Y'), 0) arrears_hh , IFNULL(SUM(y.care_burden_yn = 'Y'), 0) care_burden_hh , IFNULL(SUM(y.res_flr LIKE '지하%'), 0) ugrnd_hh , IFNULL(SUM(y.res_flr = '옥탑층'), 0) rooftop_hh , IFNULL(MAX(y.priority), 0) max_priority , IFNULL(SUM(y.priority > 0), 0) vuln_hh FROM () y
SELECT y.* FROM () y ORDER BY y.priority DESC, y.res_flr, y.resident_id
